preregistered_gate_non_discriminating_re: Two-sided book presence is ~1.0 BY CONSTRUCTION: the recorder never emits a one-sided book row (experiments/907_live_fill_probe/recorder.py:527-531, `if top is None: continue`), so the '<~50% two-sided' disqualifier cannot fire on this capture.

'AS(1h)' as pre-registered (SPEC 2.8) is a time-weighted mean relative HALF-SPREAD - a spread cost - not adverse selection / post-fill markout, so the '>>2bp' disqualifier cannot see what a resting order suffers after a fill.
The frozen-mid fraction - this row's own motivating warning - is not in the pre-registered go/no-go table.
headline.establishes: Quoted relative half-spreads are sub-bp to <1 bp (median BTC 0.006, ETH 0.22, SOL 0.94, XRP 0.75 bp) when the book is live.
headline.does_not_establish: That resting-order adverse selection is small. No markout, fill-probability or queue-position quantity was measured; no maker-viability claim is made.

G1 is re-scoped to check against the snapshot prefix (binding); it PASSES there (127,070.88s/273,233.04s vs target 127,071s/273,233s, within tolerance). The final capture's own frozen-mid time fraction is 43.39% (138,448.72s/319,092.10s BTC/USD), not 46.48% — a different, correct number for a longer file with more recorded gap time, not a defect.
